senses.gloss:
—1 An imitative sound, as of a metallic jar rolling down steps; रामाभिषेके
 मदविह्वलायाः कक्षाच्च्युतो हेमघटस्तरुण्याः । सोपानमार्गे प्रकरोति
 शब्दं ठठं ठठं ठं ठठठं ठठं ठः Subhāṣ.
—2 A loud noise.
—3 The disc of the sun or moon.
—4 A circle, globe.
—5 A cypher.
—6 A place resorted to or held sacred by all.
—7 An object of sense.
—8 An idol, deity.
—9 An epithet of Śiva.
